rationale: The workflow is a weekly scheduled Trivy security scan for container images. After evaluating all evidence-supported patterns: (1) P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE (suppress schedules during inactivity) has a direct contraindication for 'security or time-based requirements need fresh checks' — new CVEs can appear in base images even without repository changes. (2) P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (cache dependency downloads) offers only modest benefit per evidence and the Trivy DB lacks a lockfile for cache keying; the action likely handles its own caching. (3) P-LIT-ENV-CACHE (reuse validated build environments) applies to build environments, not scanning workflows. (4) P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT would not meaningfully reduce runtime (job completes in minutes vs 6h default). (5) Other patterns (matrix fail-fast, change filters, Bazel, test selection, etc.) are inapplicable to this single-job, scheduled security scan. No pattern provides a supported, safe optimization for this workflow without violating contraindications or lacking prerequisites.
